Those are pre-existing modifications from other live agents/watchers (already dirty at session start per git status snapshot), not mine to touch. My task's own files are committed; the task log reflects the landing. Task done.

**Landing: Item tool reads a dotted path, refuses read-only verbs, builds a page's own class**

- `item({path, read:"a.b.c"})` answers a path with no write; refuses when combined with `delta`; caps near 4 KB.
- A delta keyed by `get`/`find`/`toJSON`/`walk`/`root`/`contains`/`member`/`locate` is refused before any write — fixes the exact bug (`{"get":"content"}` on `/live/page.jsonl` silently doing nothing).
- `page.jsonl`'s line-1 `"class"` (relative `"./LivePage.js"` or site-absolute `"/live/LivePage.js"`) now resolves to the real subclass instead of always falling back to plain `Page`.
- New test `Servex/agents/item-read.test.mjs` (27 checks); 5 pre-existing related test files re-verified unchanged (118/40/23/6/13 checks).
- Commit `faf01c784` on `compliance/dev`, three fenced files only.
- **Needs a Servex restart** to take effect — not done, per the brief (a restart would drop the owner's voice call).
Landing line is appended and the card is answered — that's how this task completes (`close_task` is only for abandoning a task *without* landing, not needed here). Nothing further to do.
Noted — the clarity rewrite landed on the task directly, nothing further needed from me here.
